content: असाधनीय, असाध्य {%a.%} .²1 Not to be accomplished or completed, not proper, easy, or capable of being accomplished; नास्ति असाध्यं नाम मनोभुवः <ls>K. 157</ls>. .²2 Not capable of being proved; (see <ab>com.</ab> on <ls>Y. 2. 6.</ls>) .²3 Incurable, irremediable (as a disease or patient); असाध्यः कुरुते कोपं प्राप्ते काले गदो यथा <ls>Śi. 2. 84</ls>; असाध्य इति वैद्येनातुर इव <ls>V. 3</ls>; <ls>Mv. 4. 23</ls>; भिषजामसाध्यम् <ls>R. 8. 93</ls>. .²4 Not to be overpowered or mastered.
